name: Fuente el Saz de Jarama (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper fly to the lower hoist, blue above with the crowned municipal arms of Fuente el Saz de Jarama and white below with a yellow figure of the Virgin.
history: Municipal flag of Fuente el Saz de Jarama; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Fuente el Saz de Jarama arms — willow tree above waves on white
figure of the Virgin at the lower fly
